GOAL: ground one in-scope idea before writing it; check what the baseline code actually quantizes and whether a curved residual chain exists.
READ: workspace listing of ideation_1 (only session.jsonl, progress.jsonl, running.json, stderr.log, opencode.json); tool catalog search for append_progress and progress.
OBSERVED: no source tree in this agent's workspace; the baseline TIGER_CURV-RESID-CONTRAST is resolved by the framework, so the proposal must be written against the stated round-one facts (frozen Stage-1 text geometry was the only variant that trained; 3x256 codewords, CODEBOOK_DIM 32; L1 251/256, L2 1769, L3 2201 distinct prefixes; Stage2 571 s at 0.145 s/epoch, 24 steps/epoch).
REASONING: I cannot inspect code, so I anchor on the measured facts and keep the mechanism a static per-item input transformation that adds zero per-step cost and no new origin-minimizing objective (the round-one collapse mode). Chosen coupling position: item-side geodesic step before level-1 quantization, with step size = transition concentration (a measured quantity, not tuned) - distinct from the rejected codebook-Frechet, per-level-curvature, Lorentz-smoothing, behaviour-cone, successor-boost and radial-assignment mechanisms.
OPEN: nothing yet; next record is the full answer block.

FINAL RECORD (summary; full answer is printed in the reply, it exceeds the 4000-char record limit).
IDEA: CONCMID-GEO-SID - concentration-scaled geodesic step toward each item's behaviour-successor barycentre, applied to the quantizer INPUT before level-1 assignment; codebooks, losses, encoder and Stage3 untouched.
PATH: training-split directed transitions (lag1 w=1, lag2 w=0.5, self-pairs dropped, popularity-adjusted by p_j^-0.5, row-normalised to w_ij) -> concentration eta_i = sum_j w_ij^2 -> tangent sum v_i = sum_j w_ij log_{z_i}(z_j) on the unit Poincare ball (c=1, z_i = exp_0(0.9 t_i/max||t||)) -> b_i = exp_{z_i}(eta_i v_i) -> frozen 3x256 RQ chain -> SID -> frozen Stage3.
WHY IN SCOPE: behaviour term sets direction AND length of a curved displacement; eta=0 deletes the pathway (b=z, baseline); c=0 gives the flat blend b_i = z_i + eta_i sum w_ij(z_j - z_i) inside a flat RQ-VAE. Removing either changes the core computation; the exp/log is basepoint-dependent, so it is not the tangent-rescaling gauge of issue 126.
WHY IT AVOIDS ROUND-ONE FAILURES: no new objective, hence no origin minimum and no collapse; deterministic closed-form table, no tuning (0.5 skip weight, 0.5 popularity exponent, 0.9 scale, 0.995 clip are documented defaults / measured quantities); targets the prefix PARTITION (capacity problem: 1769 L2 / 2201 L3 prefixes for 24,556 items), not codebook positions; uses behaviour-CONTRAST structure (within-prefix dispersion, between-prefix separation, radial compactness) not Gromov-delta or ancestor depth, both of which issue 126 shows hurt.
DISTINCT FROM PRIOR: not successor-Frechet codebook updates, not per-level curvature from prefix-transition score, not entropy-ranked radial assignment, not Lorentz profile smoothing, not behaviour cone, not successor boost shift. It moves items, not centroids, and adds no loss term.
COST: static precompute only (~1.5e6 log maps of dim 32, ~2e8 flops, a few seconds; 3.1 MB table). At 24,556 items / 24 steps per epoch / 3000 epochs = 72,000 steps, added per-step cost is one row-gather, 0 FLOPs, no extra DDP communication: Stage2 stays at the measured 571 s (0.145 s/epoch) plus ~5 s (<1%). Stage3 unchanged at 150 epochs.
OBSERVABLES: SID-change fraction vs unsmoothed z under trained codebooks (>0.20 expected), L1 active >= 240 and L2/L3 distinct prefixes >= 1700 (collapse guard), within-prefix successor-distribution TV down and between-prefix TV up, entropy of q3 given (q1,q2,last item) down, radius-vs-compactness correlation more negative, and Stage3 test_recall@10 vs the 0.065 gate with recall@5 and ndcg@10.
ABLATIONS WIRED, NOT RUN: BEHAV_SMOOTH=False (eta=0, b=z, round-one curved frozen-geometry chain); CURV_C=0.0 (identical weights/eta as an arithmetic blend in flat R^32); both-on is the single trained arm.
OPEN: the concentration step may be near-zero for most items and the geometry may prove near-gauge for small steps; both are recorded as risks, not gates. No measurement was possible in this workspace: it holds only session/progress/running/stderr/opencode.json, no source tree and no shell, so every constant above is a documented default or a quantity measured from the training split.
